description: Every unary primitive-recursive function has a search-free recursive program computing it on all inputs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.searchFree_complete {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Nat.Primrec f) :
  ∃ c, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.SearchFree c ∧ c.eval = fun x => Part.some (f x)
